name: Oud Wood
description: A composition of rare oud wood, sandalwood, and rosewood that reveals smoky, exotic tones. Cardamom brings warmth while tonka bean and amber round the dry-down into a quietly addictive trail.

name: Baccarat Rouge 540
description: A luminous architecture of saffron and jasmine wrapped in a crystalline amber haze. The fir resin and cedarwood backbone gives it an almost ethereal glow — neither fully warm nor cool, but somewhere otherworldly.

name: Aventus
description: A bold fruity-smoky opening of pineapple and birch that dries to a mossy, musky base. A composition inspired by historic strength and vision — unapologetically masculine, widely imitated, never equaled.

name: Santal 33
description: An addictive woody scent that became an olfactory signature for an entire generation. The creamy sandalwood mingles with smoky leather and papyrus, creating an intimate, skin-like aura.

name: Gypsy Water
description: A romanticized notion of the Romani life — fresh soil after rain, campfire smoke, pine forests at dusk. The opening sparkles with bergamot and juniper before settling into a warm bed of vanilla and sandalwood.

name: Layton
description: A masterful blend of fresh apple and lavender layered over an opulent base of vanilla and guaiac wood. The cardamom and jasmine heart gives it a spiced floral warmth that lingers for hours.

name: Oud for Greatness
description: An opulent oud composition where saffron and lavender create an unexpected opening warmth. The nutmeg and patchouli add depth, while a clean musk keeps the trail elegant rather than heavy.

name: Interlude Man
description: Controlled chaos in a bottle. A dissonant, smoky opening of oregano and frankincense crashes into a resinous base of opoponax and amber. Not for the faint-hearted — this is fragrance as artistic statement.

name: Naxos
description: Mediterranean sweetness refined through tobacco and honey. The lavender opening gives way to a rich, almost gourmand heart of cinnamon and tonka, while the tobacco adds a dry, cultured sophistication.

name: Sauvage Elixir
description: The most concentrated expression of the Sauvage line. A warm, spiced intensity built on cinnamon and cardamom, grounded by a massive woody base. The licorice note adds an unusual, almost resinous sweetness.

name: Elysium
description: A crystalline, uplifting composition that captures the feeling of pure joy. Bright citruses and pink pepper float above a clean, musky base. Roja Dove's interpretation of masculine freshness at its most elevated.

name: African Leather
description: A textural composition that evokes vast open landscapes and artisanal craft. The cardamom-saffron opening settles into a supple leather heart, while oud and vetiver root the composition in earthy permanence.

name: Portrait of a Lady
description: A monumental rose composition by Dominique Ropion. Hundreds of Turkish roses are anchored by dark patchouli, frankincense, and sandalwood. The result is a portrait of feminine power, painted in deep, saturated hues.

name: Hacivat
description: A fruity-woody composition with remarkable freshness and projection. The pineapple-bergamot opening nods to Aventus territory, but the jasmine heart and mossy base carve their own path. A crowd-pleaser with artistic intent.

name: Halfeti
description: Named after a submerged Turkish village, Halfeti captures the mystery of black roses growing along the Euphrates. A dark, lush floral wrapped in frankincense and oud — romantic, melancholy, and deeply evocative.

name: Kirke
description: A lush, fruity-floral composition named after the enchantress of Greek mythology. The passion fruit and peach opening is intoxicating, while the patchouli and vanilla base gives it longevity and a warm, sensuous trail.

name: Tobacco Vanille
description: An opulent, decadent composition built around tobacco leaf and creamy vanilla. The cacao and dried fruits add depth, while the spices keep it from becoming saccharine. A quintessential evening fragrance.

name: Tam Dao
description: A meditation in sandalwood. Three varieties of the precious wood are layered with rosewood and cedar, creating a quiet, contemplative aura. This is the scent of a temple interior — sacred, calming, timeless.
